name: Jeeter | 1.3g Solventless Infused Cannon | Mellow Mami
description: Introducing a new Cannon to the arsenal. Jeeter Solventless Cannons combine the artisanal live rosin experience with top-quality flower, meticulously chosen to deliver a nuanced, connoisseur smoking experience. Live Rosin is a natural solventless cannabis concentrate derived from pressing ice-water hash. This process yields a concentrate that offers perhaps the truest flavor experience of cannabis, as it gently extracts aromatic compounds without degradation.
